title: Build, type-export, and publish pipeline + test harness
description: Finalize the library for distribution: confirm the Vite library build emits clean ESM plus generated `.d.ts`, verify the published `exports`/`types`/`peerDependencies`, and set up a GitHub-based release flow (tagged versions installable by URL or git ref) with semver discipline since every exported symbol is public API. Add a test harness covering the read query, the PortableText renderer, the Claude generation path (mocked), and the save round-trip (mocked write layer), runnable in CI.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` emits ESM + `.d.ts`; importing the package in a fresh TS project resolves types with no errors.
A tagged GitHub release is installable into another project via the documented method.
CI runs unit tests for the read query, renderer, AI generation (mocked), and save round-trip (mocked).
Public exports are reviewed against the semver-major rule and recorded in a changelog.

comments.author: init-project
comments.body: Reshaped from generic seed. Library semver discipline per project-context type guidance.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: SCOPE ADD (from TASK-004 and TASK-006 reviews): tsconfig.build.json excludes tests/, so `npm run typecheck` (vue-tsc) never type-checks the spec files — vitest only esbuild-transpiles them (no type checking). Add a CI typecheck pass that includes tests/ (e.g. a tsconfig.test.json / separate vue-tsc invocation) so type regressions in the public contract exercised by tests are caught. Fold into the CI pipeline for this ticket.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CONFIRMED REAL (TASK-007 review): typechecking with the full tsconfig.json (which includes tests/) surfaces pre-existing TYPE ERRORS in tests/ai-generate.spec.ts, tests/render-preview.spec.ts, and tests/write-adapter.spec.ts — currently hidden because vitest's esbuild strips types without checking. When this ticket adds the tests/ typecheck pass, those spec type errors must be fixed as part of it. (blog-author.spec.ts is type-clean.)
